fullContent:
Karpooradi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam – Taila Yoga Prakarana 
 Introduction 
 Karpooradi Thailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic herbal oil, prepared from sesame oil or coconut oil base. It is used in various joint pains, muscular pain, rheumatic complaints, muscle cramps etc. It is also known as Karpuradi tailam. 
 Ingredients 
 It is prepared either in coconut oil or Sesame oil base. 
 
 Camphor – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Ajowain – Trachyspermum ammi 
 
 Indications 
 
 Muscular pain 
 Inflammation 
 Gout, arthritis, rheumatism 
 Joint pain, neck pain, back pain and stiffness 
 muscle pain and stiffness 
 chest congestion 
 Improves blood circulation and brings about warmth. 
 
 How to Use? 
 Used for external application only. Warm Oil and apply on affected areas and massage gently. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
